archetypes.name: scope-control
archetypes.rationale: The plan appears to add Step 0 parent-shell behavior beyond the issue anchor's approved SKILL.md Step 5 surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the staged issue scope and approved surfaces against every proposed file and behavior change. Look for plan steps that expand beyond items 1, 3, and 4 or introduce new Step 0 parent-shell behavior not justified by the issue anchor, and distinguish necessary fixes from scope creep. Check whether added tests, docs, Makefile entries, and agent-lint entries are support wiring for in-scope work or unnecessary machinery. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-fence-flow
archetypes.rationale: The plan relies on multi-line Bash fences and env rehydration where syntax or subprocess lifetime mistakes would recreate the reported friction.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit proposed Bash snippets in SKILL.md and scripts for syntactic completeness, Bash 3.2 compatibility, and variable lifetime across subprocess versus parent shell. Pay special attention to inserted conditional blocks, exported env vars, command substitutions, and whether values consumed by later lines are available in the same Bash invocation. Verify the plan aligns with existing Step 0 and Step 5 fence structure rather than relying on prompt-side state. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-wiring
archetypes.rationale: The plan adds or extends harnesses plus Makefile and agent-lint wiring, which is easy to under-specify in this repo.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace each proposed behavioral contract to a regression test, Makefile target, shard entry, and any agent-lint or script-sibling exception the repository requires. Look for missing targets, duplicate or stale PHONY entries, harness names that do not match sibling docs, or tests that cannot exercise the changed contract. Keep the review anchored to the in-scope helper scripts and Step 5 or Step 0 prose edits. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: The changes touch script CLIs, sibling docs, quiet KV output, and sourced-library semantics that must stay synchronized.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare every proposed script contract change with its sibling markdown, existing consumers, and quiet-by-default KV conventions. Look for mismatched argv, exit codes, stdout or stderr promises, ordering assumptions, or docs that would leave operators guessing valid flags. For lib-style changes, verify the plan preserves source-versus-exec behavior and documents the CLI without drifting sourced-library semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
